description: Least-privilege set for the main window. Deliberately narrowed from core:default (0.11.0): core:path / core:image / core:resources / core:menu / core:tray are unused by this app and were dropped — core:image's allow-from-path has no scope and is an arbitrary-file-read primitive in principle. Retained: app (getVersion for the updater panel), event (listen/emit for open-pdf and window-state events), webview (drag-drop event surface), window getters (isMaximized for the title bar) plus exactly the window actions the title bar invokes. Note windows:["main"] only gates plugin commands — local-origin app commands are always allowed (no app ACL manifest is declared; see docs/PLAN-1.0.md §3.3 for the reasoning).
